references.text: Detailed laws about leprosy in clothing, as elaborated in chapter 14:55. This section describes how to examine and treat leprosy in wool, linen, and leather.
The laws concerning leprosy in houses mentioned in verse 55. This section gives detailed instructions on how the priest is to examine and cleanse a house affected by leprosy.
Moses reminds the Israelites to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, referring back to the laws in Leviticus.
